sidebars.body_markdown: The company is listing on NSE EMERGE, the SME platform of the National Stock Exchange [^drhp-p75]. The stated objects are to fund capital expenditure for a new manufacturing facility at GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat, and general corporate purposes [^drhp-p75]. The DRHP names Vivro Financial Services Private Limited [^drhp-p54] and Link Intime India Private Limited [^drhp-p55], though their roles are not disclosed in the available pages. The offer size, price band, and whether the issue is a fresh issue or an offer for sale are not disclosed in the available excerpts.
